extensionDescription.message: Fills, shows and saves logins from the desktop password manager. Keeps no passwords itself: every one comes from the app, which asks for Windows Hello or your PIN.

notRunningText.message: Open the password manager on this computer and turn on Settings → Browser extension. Then click this button again.

lockedText.message: Unlock it in the app. To fill while it is locked, turn on Settings → Browser extension → Fill with Windows Hello while the vault is locked.

insecureText.message: Anything typed here can be read on the way, so logins are not filled on it.

notAWebsiteText.message: Logins are filled on websites only.

noLoginsTitle.message: No login saved for this site

noLoginsText.message: A login is offered only on the exact site saved in it ($ORIGIN$). Check the website of the item in the app if you expected one.

pinText.message: Locked. Your PIN opens it for this fill only.

passwordText.message: Locked. Your item password opens it for this fill only.

wrongCheck.message: That isn't it. $LEFT$ tries left before the vault locks.

wrongCheckLast.message: That isn't it. One more wrong try locks the vault.

pairText.message: Do this once. Connect opens the password manager, where you type your master password. No password is typed or kept here.

pairWaitText.message: The password manager asks for the code below, then your master password: type both there. This window carries on by itself once you connect.

itemLockedText.message: This login is behind the item lock, which asks for your master password. Open it in the app, then try again. To open logins from here, choose a PIN in the app's Settings → Item lock.

pageChanged.message: The page changed before it was filled. Nothing was typed.

noFields.message: No sign-in fields were found on this page. Nothing was typed.

filledUsername.message: Username filled. Continue to the password step, then click the button again.

failed.message: That didn't work. Nothing was typed.

goneTitle.message: That login is no longer there

goneText.message: It was removed or changed in the app. Close this window and open it again.

vaultEmpty.message: No logins in this vault yet. Add one in the app, or sign in to a site and choose Save.

copiedSecret.message: Copied by the app. The clipboard is cleared in $SECONDS$ seconds.

entryAsks.message: Locked. Showing, copying or filling it asks for $CHECK$.

saveTitle.message: Save this login to your vault?

saveFailed.message: Not saved. Check that the app is running, then try again.

savedQueued.message: Saved. It goes into your vault the next time you unlock it.

offerText.message: You signed in as $USERNAME$. Save this login to your vault?

genNote.message: Made by the app. Copy is done by the app too: out of clipboard history and cleared after a while.

genImpossible.message: Choose at least one kind of character.

nameHint.message: The site's name when left empty

newSiteError.message: Type the site's address, for example example.com. Only https sites.

newExists.message: A login with this username is already saved for this site.

suggestNote.message: $LENGTH$ characters, fitting this site's rules. You'll be asked to save the login after you sign up.

pairAgainTitle.message: The app doesn't know this extension any more

pairAgainText.message: It was disconnected in the app, or another vault is open there. Connect again: the app asks for your master password.

noCodeField.message: No field for a one-time code on this page

offerUpdateText.message: You signed in as $USERNAME$ with another password. Update the one saved?

updatedToast.message: Password updated. The old one is in the login's history.

prefsSaving.message: Vault offers to save passwords, not the browser

prefsSavingHint.message: Turns off the browser's own “Offer to save passwords and passkeys”, so only Vault asks. The browser's settings then say that Vault controls it; turning this off gives it back.

prefsSavingOther.message: Another extension controls this browser setting. Turn that one off to let Vault have it.

prefsSavingPolicy.message: Your organization controls this browser setting.
